vocab.example: I made a mistake in the report, but I fixed it before the meeting.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi mắc lỗi trong báo cáo, nhưng đã sửa trước cuộc họp.

vocab.example: After the project, I took time to reflect on what went wrong.
vocab.example_vi: Sau dự án, tôi dành thời gian nhìn lại những gì đã sai.

vocab.example: We recovered quickly and delivered the product only two days late.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi khắc phục nhanh và giao sản phẩm chỉ trễ hai ngày.

vocab.example: I admitted my mistake to my manager right away.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi đã thừa nhận lỗi với quản lý ngay lập tức.

vocab.example: I believe we can grow from every difficult experience.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi tin rằng chúng ta có thể trưởng thành từ mọi trải nghiệm khó khăn.

vocab.example: Can you tell me about a failure and what you did next?
vocab.example_vi: Bạn có thể kể về một thất bại và bạn đã làm gì sau đó không?

vocab.example: I learned from that project to ask more questions at the start.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi rút kinh nghiệm từ dự án đó là phải hỏi nhiều hơn ngay từ đầu.

vocab.example: I created a checklist to prevent the same problem in the future.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi tạo một checklist để ngăn vấn đề tương tự trong tương lai.

listening.title: Talking about a failure in an interview

lines.speaker: Hằng (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: Tùng, can you tell me about a failure in your career?

lines.speaker: Tùng (Candidate)
lines.text: Sure. Two years ago, I led the launch of a mobile app, and it crashed on the first day.

lines.speaker: Hằng (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: That sounds stressful. What caused the problem?

lines.speaker: Tùng (Candidate)
lines.text: I didn't plan enough load testing. I thought our usual tests were enough.

lines.speaker: Hằng (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: What did you do after that?

lines.speaker: Tùng (Candidate)
lines.text: First, I admitted the mistake to my manager. Then the team worked all night, and we recovered in about twelve hours.

lines.speaker: Hằng (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: And what did you learn from it?

lines.speaker: Tùng (Candidate)
lines.text: I learned to test with real user numbers before every launch. I also wrote a release checklist to prevent this.

lines.speaker: Hằng (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: Did the team use the checklist later?

lines.speaker: Tùng (Candidate)
lines.text: Yes. We used it for the next five releases without any big problems. I really grew from that experience.

questions.q: What happened on the first day of the app launch?
How long did it take the team to recover?
What did Tùng create to prevent the problem?

shadowing: In my last project, I missed a deadline because I didn't ask for help early.
I admitted my mistake to the client and offered a clear plan to fix it.
We recovered quickly, and the client was happy with the final result.
Since then, I reflect on every project and write down what I can improve.
That failure taught me to check details carefully and to prevent the same problem.
